CYLColor: `UIColor` (UIKit; Android stand-in: colors as ARGB ints)
Map: `NSDictionary.cyl_descriptionWithLocale(_:)` (`NSDictionary+CYLLog.swift`; the Android row is the `Map<*, *>.cyl_descriptionWithLocale` extension)
CYLCollectionViewLeftAlignedLayout.frame: `CYLCollectionViewLeftAlignedLayout.layoutAttributesForElements(in:)` (UIKit computes the frames; Android's helper returns them for its own list view)
CYLImageTagGroupViewDelegate.handlesLong: `CYLImageTagGroupViewDelegate.groupViewDidLongPress(_:)` (a Swift protocol method with a default; Android needs a flag instead of `respondsToSelector:`)
CYLImageTagGroupView.pointInside: `CYLImageTagGroupView.point(inside:with:)` (only the dot and the tags take touches)
CYLMenuIconDrawable: the bundle images `cyl_fold_chevron`, `cyl_tag_plus`, `cyl_more` (`CYLMenuResources.image(named:)`, SF Symbol fallback); Android draws them
CYLFilterParamsTool.filesDir: N/A on iOS: `CYLFilterParamsTool` was removed in the Swift migration (`70dcc816`); `CYLMultipleFilterController` keeps its state (`selectedIndexPaths()` / `setSelectedIndexPaths(_:)`)
CYLIndexPathButton.cyl_titleLeadingInset: `CYLMenuStyle.sectionTitle(leadingInset:)` (the leading content inset of a `CYLTagButton`'s style)
CYLTagImagePlacement.isVertical: `imagePlacement == .top || imagePlacement == .bottom` (`CYLTagImagePlacement.cylIsVertical`, internal to the Swift core)
CYLTagAppearance.resolvedTextColor: N/A on iOS: `CYLTagAppearance.textColor` is a dynamic `UIColor` (`defaultTextColor`) that UIKit resolves with the view's traits; Android has no dynamic colors, so it resolves the night-mode default from a `Context`
CYLTagListView.headerSeparator: N/A on iOS: a field of Android's internal `CYLTagListSectionFrame` (the layout pass records the frames it paints itself); iOS draws the divider in the header view (`header.separatorThickness`) and the card in the `CYLTagListCardSpec` decoration, no public frame
CYLTagListView.headerInsetLeft: N/A on iOS: a field of Android's internal `CYLTagListSectionFrame` (see `headerSeparator`); the header's insets are laid out by UIKit
CYLTagListView.headerInsetRight: N/A on iOS: a field of Android's internal `CYLTagListSectionFrame` (see `headerSeparator`); the header's insets are laid out by UIKit
CYLTagListView.backdropSource: N/A on iOS: Android only. iOS draws real glass that samples what is behind it by itself (`UIGlassEffect`), so no source view is needed; on Android the glass samples its backdrop source (default: the window root, which contains the list, so a tag in a list draws only tint and rim) and `backdropSource` names a sibling plate behind the list (docs/tag-section-style.md "Android backdropSource")
CYLMenuColorLuminance: `CYLTintContrast.relativeLuminance(red:green:blue:)` (the WCAG relative luminance of an opaque color, the contrast rule of the default tint; iOS takes the components in 0...1, Android the color as an Int)
CYLTintLuminanceThreshold: `CYLTintContrast.luminanceThreshold` (the light/dark cut-off of the default tint: 0.179 on the WCAG relative luminance scale, the same on both platforms)
CYLIconContrast: `CYLIconContrast` (the dark-glass icon lift: an explicit icon color too dark for dark glass is lifted to 3:1, hue and saturation kept; Android colors are Int and never dynamic)
CYLIconContrast.lightnessStep: N/A on iOS: the lift's 0.005 lightness step is a literal inside `CYLIconContrast.liftedIconColor`; Android names it
CYLIconContrast.glassReferenceLuminance: `CYLIconContrast.glassReferenceLuminance(glassTint:tintAlpha:)` (Android takes the tint as an Int, alpha from the color)
CYLMenuStyle.explicitIconColorForState: N/A on iOS: the explicit-icon-color check is done inside `CYLTagButton` (the style's per-state icon color is optional there); Android's internal accessor mirrors `explicitBackgroundColor`
CYL_FOLD_CONTROL_MAX_FONT_SCALE: `CYLTagFoldButton.maximumContentSizeCategory` (the largest size the fold / More control scales to; iOS caps by content size category (accessibilityMedium), Android by a font scale factor (1.3))
CYLSectionStyleColors.CARD: `CYLSectionStyleColors.card` (the light value of the dynamic color)
CYLSectionStyleColors.CARD_DARK: `CYLSectionStyleColors.card` (the dark value of the dynamic color)
CYLSectionStyleColors.HEADER_BAND: `CYLSectionStyleColors.headerBand` (the light value of the dynamic color)
CYLSectionStyleColors.HEADER_BAND_DARK: `CYLSectionStyleColors.headerBand` (the dark value of the dynamic color)
CYLSectionStyleColors.GROUPED_BACKGROUND: `CYLSectionStyleColors.groupedBackground` (the light value of the dynamic color)
`CYLSectionStyleColors.groupedBackground` (the dark value of the dynamic color)
CYLSectionStyleColors.SEPARATOR: `CYLSectionStyleColors.separator` (the light value of the dynamic color)
CYLSectionStyleColors.SEPARATOR_DARK: `CYLSectionStyleColors.separator` (the dark value of the dynamic color)
